metadata.description: Contributions, aid cases and monthly reports for the Ehsas Program welfare fund of Megowal village.

landing.about: Ehsas Program is a welfare fund run by the people of Megowal village. Members give a fixed amount every month, and the fund helps families in need with weddings, funerals, medical treatment, school fees and other needs. Every rupee is recorded openly.
landing.loginNote: Members and heads log in with their mobile number.

transparent.title: Open accounts
transparent.body: Every month's report shows the total collected, the total spent and the balance.

aid.title: Help tracked to the end
aid.body: Every aid case is followed from request to completion, and families' names stay private.

members.title: Check anytime
members.body: Members can see their contributions, pending months and reports on their phone.

login.title: Log in
login.subtitle: Enter your mobile number and password.
login.forgot: Forgot your password? Ask the admin to reset it.

account.name: Name
account.changePasswordSubtitle: Use at least 8 characters. Do not share it with anyone.
account.forcedSubtitle: You logged in with a temporary password. Choose your own password to continue.
account.languageSubtitle: Choose the language for your screens.

users.title: Users
users.subtitle: People who can log in to the app
users.emptyBody: Try a different search, or add a user.

form.createSubtitle: A temporary password is made for the new user.
form.name: Full name
form.memberHint: Required for members. Heads can be linked to their own member record.

users.confirmDisableBody: They will not be able to log in until you enable them again.
users.confirmResetBody: A new temporary password will be made. Their old password stops working straight away.
users.tempBody: Give this password to {name}. They must change it after logging in. It will not be shown again.

members.title: Members
members.subtitle: Everyone who gives to the fund
members.exportLabel: Download the members list as an Excel file

members.emptyBody: Try a different search or status.
members.noMembersBody: Add the first member to start keeping records.
members.pendingSoon: Pending amounts will show once monthly contributions are set up.

form.createSubtitle: The member number is given automatically.
form.name: Full name
form.mobileHint: Optional. Needed to create a login.
form.mohallaHint: Pick one from the list or type a new name.
form.joinDateHint: Monthly contributions start from this month.
form.notesHint: Optional. Anything the heads should remember.

status.subtitle: Current status of {name}: {status}.
status.billingNote: Left, deceased and exempt members get no monthly bill for any month that starts on or after this date.
status.deceasedNote: Their member login, if they have one, will be turned off.
status.historyEmpty: Active since joining. No changes yet.

login.title: App login
login.none: This member cannot log in yet.
login.confirmBody: They will log in with {mobile}. A temporary password will be made and shown only once.
login.needsMobile: Add a mobile number to this member first.
login.deceased: Logins cannot be made for deceased members.
login.mustChange: Has not set own password yet
login.adminNote: Only the admin can reset the password, on the Users page.

contributions.emptyBody: Monthly bills, payments and the pending amount for this member will show here once contributions are set up.

activity.emptyBody: Changes to this member will be listed here.

payments.title: Payments
payments.pickMember: Find the member who is paying.
payments.pickNoMatch: Try a different name, member number or mobile.
payments.searchPlaceholder: Name, member no. or receipt no.
payments.emptyBody: Payments you receive will be listed here with their receipts.
payments.openingDueHint: Carried over from the paper register. Paid first.
payments.advanceHint: Ticking a month also pays every month before it.
payments.noAdvanceInactive: This member is not active, so future months cannot be paid in advance.
payments.tooMuch: This is more than can be paid now. The most is {max}.
payments.noAccounts: There is no account to receive money into. Add one first:

receipt.title: Receipt
receipt.thanks: Thank you for supporting the village welfare fund.
receipt.computerMade: This receipt was made by computer and needs no signature.
receipt.savedNotice: Payment saved. Send the receipt to the member on WhatsApp.
receipt.noMobile: This member has no mobile number, so the receipt cannot be sent on WhatsApp.
receipt.cancelBody: The payment stays in the records marked as cancelled, and the months it paid become unpaid again.
receipt.cancelPlaceholder: For example: entered twice by mistake
receipt.cancelOwnHint: You received this payment, so only the other head or the admin can cancel it.

pending.title: Pending dues
pending.subtitle: Who still has to pay, month by month
pending.billsMade: Bills made for {made} of {total} members in {month}
pending.noRate: No rate covers this month yet. Ask the admin to add one in Settings.
pending.waived: {count, plural, one {# bill waived} other {# bills waived}}
pending.generateDone: {created, plural, one {# bill made} other {# bills made}}. {existing} already had a bill.
pending.generateNone: No new bills needed. All {existing} members already have a bill for this month.
pending.listTitle: {count, plural, one {# member owes} other {# members owe}} {amount}
pending.listHint: Unpaid months up to {month}, plus old dues from the paper register.
pending.allClearBody: Every member has paid up to this month.

ledger.waiveBody: The member will not have to pay this {amount}. The bill stays in the records with your reason.
ledger.waivePlaceholder: For example: family in hospital this month
ledger.emptyBody: Bills appear when the heads generate a month, and payments when money is received.

cases.title: Aid cases
cases.subtitle: {open, plural, =0 {No open cases} one {# open case} other {# open cases}}
cases.subtitleAttention: {open, plural, one {# open case} other {# open cases}} · {attention} need attention
cases.emptyBody: Open a case when a family in the village asks for help.
cases.noMatchBody: Try another tab or clear the filters.
cases.namesShown: Members can see the name and details of this case.
cases.namesHidden: Name and details are hidden from members.

form.createSubtitle: The case number is given automatically.
form.guardianHint: Father, husband or whoever looks after the family.
form.recommendedByHint: The member or person who brought the case.
form.descriptionPlaceholder: For example: daughter's wedding on 20 Nov, needs help with dowry and food.
form.expectedDateHint: Optional. Wedding date, operation date, fee deadline…
form.showNameHint: Off by default to protect the family's dignity. Turn on only if the family agrees.

status.title: Change status of {caseNo}
status.approvedAmountHint: How much the fund will give for this case.
status.reasonPlaceholder: For example: Larki walon se tareekh confirm ho gayi
status.membersSeeReason: Members can read this reason in their case list. Do not write the family's name here.

notes.title: Notes
notes.placeholder: Write a note for the heads (members do not see notes)

disbursements.title: Payments to this case
disbursements.emptyBody: Money paid out for this case will be listed here once disbursements are recorded.

memberCases.title: Aid cases
memberCases.subtitle: Where the fund's money is helping
memberCases.privacy: Families' names are kept private to protect their dignity. A name is shown only when the family has agreed.
memberCases.emptyBody: Cases the fund is helping with will show here.

photo.label: Receipt photo (optional)
photo.hint: Take a photo or pick one. It is made small before uploading.
photo.disabled: Photo upload is not set up yet (Cloudflare R2 settings are missing). You can still save without a photo.
photo.uploadFailed: The photo could not be uploaded. Check the internet and try again, or save without it.
photo.photoRead: This file could not be read as a photo.

disbursements.receivedByHint: Who took the money: the family, a shopkeeper, the hospital…
disbursements.nothingLeft: The approved amount is fully paid or waiting for approval. Raise the approved amount to pay more.
disbursements.notPayableYet: Money can be paid out once the case is approved.
disbursements.emptyBody: Payments made to this family will be listed here with their receipt photos.
disbursements.waitingOther: Waiting for another head to approve
disbursements.rejectBody: The payment stays in the records as rejected and no money leaves the account.
disbursements.approvedFullyPaid: Payment approved. The case is now fully paid.
disbursements.willWait: This is above {limit}, so it will wait until another head or the admin approves it. The account balance does not change until then.
disbursements.savedPending: Saved. It now waits for another head to approve it.
disbursements.changeApprovedBody: Now approved: {amount}. The change and your reason are shown on the timeline.
disbursements.notBelow: Cannot be less than what is paid or waiting: {amount}.
disbursements.changeReasonPlaceholder: For example: hospital bill came higher than expected
disbursements.fullyPaidStart: The approved amount has been paid in full. Move the case to in progress, then mark it completed.
disbursements.fullyPaidComplete: The approved amount has been paid in full. Mark the case completed?

expenses.title: Expenses
expenses.subtitle: Program costs not tied to a case · {month}: {amount}
expenses.addHint: Stationery, printing, transport and other running costs.
expenses.emptyBody: Running costs like printing and transport will be listed here.

transfers.title: Transfers
transfers.addHint: Move money between the fund's own accounts, for example cash deposited into the bank.
transfers.notePlaceholder: For example: cash deposited at HBL Megowal
transfers.needTwo: Add a second account to move money between accounts.

dashboard.approvalOn: Payments above {limit} need a second head's approval.
dashboard.approvalOff: Second-head approval is off (admin can turn it on in Settings).

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.subtitle: Where the fund's money is kept
accounts.addHint: Cash with a head, a bank account or a mobile wallet.
accounts.balanceNote: Balance = opening + received − aid paid − expenses ± transfers. Payments waiting for approval are not taken off yet.
accounts.emptyBody: Add an account (for example Cash in hand) before receiving payments.

form.name: Account name
form.namePlaceholder: For example: Cash with Aslam sahib
form.holderHint: The head or admin who keeps this money.
form.openingBalanceHint: Money already in this account when it is added.

rates.title: Contribution rates
rates.subtitle: The monthly amount each member gives, and its history
rates.addHint: The rate applies from the chosen month until a newer rate starts.
rates.effectiveFromHint: First month billed at this rate.
rates.notePlaceholder: For example: agreed in the October meeting
rates.billsKeepAmount: Bills already made keep their amount. A new rate only applies to bills made after it is added.
rates.emptyBody: Add the monthly contribution rate before generating bills.

approvals.title: Second-head approval
approvals.subtitle: Large aid payments need a second person
approvals.enabled: Ask a second head to approve large payments
approvals.enabledHint: Payments above the limit wait until another head (not the one who entered it) or the admin approves them.
approvals.limitHint: Payments above this amount need approval.
